train_main module

train_main.build_callbacks(config, results_dir)[source]

Assembles the standard and custom Keras training callbacks.

Sets up structural training components including early stopping criteria, learning rate decay on plateaus, checkpoint monitoring for validation loss, and CSV logging. Dynamically appends scheduling callbacks for physics and Gumbel constraints if toggled in hyperparameters.

Parameters:

  • config (dict) -- The complete configuration parameter dictionary.

  • results_dir (pathlib.Path) -- The destination directory path where checkpoints and loss history logs will be saved.

Returns:

A list populated with configured Keras callback objects.

Return type:

list

train_main.build_results_dir(config)[source]

Builds a uniquely named experiment results directory with a timestamp.

Extracts crucial hyperparameters (latent dimensions, filters, batch size, alpha) and constructs a descriptive path string, appending physics loss constraints if active. Automatically handles the parent directory creation.

Parameters:

config (dict) -- The full configuration dictionary containing 'hyperparams' and 'train_params' blocks.

Returns:

A Path object pointing to the newly initialized directory.

Return type:

pathlib.Path

train_main.load_config(config_path)[source]

Loads the model and training configuration parameters from a JSON file.

Parameters:

config_path (str or pathlib.Path) -- The path to the target JSON configuration file.

Returns:

A dictionary containing parsed configuration and hyperparameter blocks.

Return type:

dict

train_main.main()[source]

Main execution function to initialize and run CVAE model training.

Parses configuration inputs, configures deterministic global seeds, loads Ising model binary datasets, instantiates the CVAE architecture, builds the callback routine array, executes the training fit process, and logs the latest valid run path tracking token.

train_main.save_config(config, path)[source]

Saves the current configuration dictionary as an organized JSON file.

Maintains reproducibility by archiving an exact copy of the configuration settings inside the newly generated experiment results folder.

Parameters:

  • config (dict) -- The configuration dictionary to be archived.

  • path (pathlib.Path) -- The target directory where 'config.json' will be written.
